authority.origin: Local Government Directory (LGD), Ministry of Panchayati Raj, Government of India; hosted by the National Informatics Centre (https://lgdirectory.gov.in)
authority.mirror: https://github.com/planemad/india-local-government-directory (administrative/ folder), community maintained, not an official publication

reference.caution: PROVISIONAL: a third-party mirror of LGD as of December 2022. It is not a verified current registry; post-2022 districts stay unresolved.

policy: A label resolves only by a reviewed decision or an exact case/whitespace-insensitive match. There is no fuzzy matching.
Unresolved, ambiguous and rejected identities are never merged; their rows are quarantined (states) or kept with a source-label identity (districts, mandis).
Districts resolve only inside their resolved state. Markets have no authoritative list: they are created from source labels as unverified.

districts.note: Districts absent from the December 2022 reference (created or renamed since) are unresolved. They are not invented.

mandis.note: Every mandi is "unverified": there is no authoritative market list. Mandis whose district is unresolved carry the source district label as their identity.
